Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse NpcEquipment.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcEquipment.Builder
Umschließende Klasse:
NpcEquipment
public static final class NpcEquipment.Builder extends Object
Builds NpcEquipment instances.

Not thread safe; build on one thread and share the immutable result.

    • set

      public NpcEquipment.Builder set(org.bukkit.inventory.EquipmentSlot slot, org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item)
      Sets or clears a slot.

      The item is cloned, so later changes to the argument do not affect the built equipment.

      Parameter:
      slot - the slot to set
      item - the item, or null or air to clear the slot
      Gibt zurück:
      this builder
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if slot is null
